projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The sleep tracker syncs at 00:12/00:17 occurred without any presence shifts or camera activity, confirming the ~10-hour duration reflects ongoing rest rather than a completed cycle; this means the entire household is likely still asleep, and all morning automations should be deferred until confirmed awake.

Both adults reporting ~10 hours of sleep at midnight, paired with a stable ~25 device count and zero motion, indicates the sleep trackers are syncing stale data from the previous night rather than current rest. The high device count likely reflects smart home hubs and personal electronics rather than active occupants, confirming a normal quiet Saturday night.

The sustained 23–25 device count paired with zero camera motion and no dog activity over four hours strongly suggests either network presence drift (stale connections) or a stationary gathering like a movie or game night, rather than normal household movement. Given the late Friday hour, a quick network check or confirmation of the gathering status is advisable.

The sustained 21-25 device count paired with zero camera motion and no dog activity strongly suggests a stationary, contained gathering (like a movie or gaming night) rather than normal household movement, indicating the group is likely in a specific zone with controlled lighting or sensors. This is likely a planned social event, but worth confirming to rule out network miscounting or a security blind spot.

The sustained presence of ~20 devices paired with zero camera motion and no dog activity over four hours strongly indicates the household is gathered in a single common area for a prolonged stationary activity, likely a Friday movie or gaming night. This pattern is typical for family downtime but warrants a quick camera check to rule out a motion detection failure.

The sustained 20+ device count paired with zero camera motion and no dog activity for four hours strongly suggests a camera system anomaly or network failure rather than normal occupancy, warranting a quick diagnostic check.

The sustained 20-24 device count combined with zero camera motion and no dog activity strongly indicates the household is in a prolonged low-activity state (e.g., movie night, gaming, or everyone resting in separate rooms) rather than being away, which is typical for a Friday evening but suggests automations should remain in 'home/quiet' mode rather than triggering away routines.

The sustained 21-24 device count combined with zero camera motion and no dog activity on a Friday afternoon strongly suggests a quiet indoor gathering or family visit, with occupants likely in non-camera zones or resting.

The sustained 21-25 device count paired with zero camera motion over four hours strongly indicates a large group is gathered in a camera-blind zone or engaged in a stationary activity like a movie or gaming session, rather than normal household movement.

The sustained 21-25 device count paired with zero camera motion on a Friday afternoon strongly indicates a gathering in a camera-blind zone or a potential camera system outage; verify feeds to rule out a fault.
